# PaceBowl Pet Nutrition (https://pacebowl.com)

> PaceBowl provides free, veterinary-standard dog and cat feeding, BARF/PMR raw diet, 7-day kibble transition, and puppy adult weight calculators calibrated against WSAVA, NRC 2006, and AAFCO guidelines, with instant printable A4 fridge charts and plain-text algorithm specifications.

## Machine-Readable Resources & Algorithm Specs
- [Agent Skills Index](https://pacebowl.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Structured tool schemas for AI search agents
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://pacebowl.com/llms-full.txt): Complete veterinary formulas and reference tables
- [XML Sitemap](https://pacebowl.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of all 10 PaceBowl pages
- [Dog Calorie Algorithm (Markdown)](https://pacebowl.com/tools/dog-calorie-feeding-calculator/algorithm.md): Plain-text WSAVA RER/DER equations
- [BARF Raw Diet Algorithm (Markdown)](https://pacebowl.com/tools/barf-raw-dog-food-calculator/algorithm.md): Plain-text 70/10/5/5/7/2/1 and 80/10/10 equations
- [7-Day Transition Algorithm (Markdown)](https://pacebowl.com/tools/dog-food-transition-calculator/algorithm.md): Plain-text calorie-matched kibble mixing equations
- [Cat Wet/Dry Algorithm (Markdown)](https://pacebowl.com/tools/cat-calorie-feeding-calculator/algorithm.md): Plain-text feline DER and wet-can subtraction equations
- [Puppy Weight Algorithm (Markdown)](https://pacebowl.com/tools/puppy-adult-weight-calculator/algorithm.md): Plain-text breed-size growth curve equations

## Core Tools & Direct Landing Pages
- [Dog Calorie & Feeding Calculator](https://pacebowl.com/tools/dog-calorie-feeding-calculator/): WSAVA RER/DER daily kcal, grams, oz, and cups per meal calculator
- [BARF & PMR Raw Dog Food Calculator](https://pacebowl.com/tools/barf-raw-dog-food-calculator/): 70/10/5/5/7/2/1 BARF and 80/10/10 PMR daily grams & 7–30 day freezer batch prep planner
- [7-Day Dog Food Transition Calculator](https://pacebowl.com/tools/dog-food-transition-calculator/): Calorie-matched 7/10/14-day old vs. new kibble mixing chart
- [Cat Calorie & Wet/Dry Food Calculator](https://pacebowl.com/tools/cat-calorie-feeding-calculator/): Indoor cat mixed wet can + dry kibble gram calculator
- [Puppy Adult Weight Calculator](https://pacebowl.com/tools/puppy-adult-weight-calculator/): Breed-size growth curve predictor from 6 to 52 weeks

## E-E-A-T Trust, Methodology & Governance
- [Veterinary Nutrition Methodology](https://pacebowl.com/methodology/): WSAVA, NRC 2006, and AAFCO formula calibration & audit policy
- [About PaceBowl Pet Nutrition](https://pacebowl.com/about/): Editorial mission, slow-feeding philosophy, and 48-hour variance review
- [Privacy Policy](https://pacebowl.com/privacy/): 100% client-side computation, zero login, cookieless analytics
- [Terms & Veterinary Disclaimer](https://pacebowl.com/terms/): Educational use boundaries and clinical safety notice
